summary: Backend-agnostic validation engine. Checks are an IR (ValueRule, RowRule, ScalarRule, RelationRule, ForeignKeyRule, DistributionRule) compiled through the expression/relation visitors and executed by ValidationRunner, which returns CheckSummary / ValidationResult / DAGValidationResult with a failure-case schema keyed by row identity. Also provides FK check generation, identity resolution, JSON Schema and GeoJSON/TopoJSON checks, and table-schema semantic validation.
key_classes: ValidationRunner — executes checks per relation/DAG via validate_relation / validate_dag without backend-specific code
RowIdentity — tiered row identity for failure cases
CheckSummary / ValidationResult / DAGValidationResult — result model with its own failure-case schema
ValueRule / RowRule / ScalarRule / RelationRule / ForeignKeyRule / DistributionRule — check-type IR
key_functions: ValidationRunner.validate_relation(...) — run checks against a Relation
build_fk_checks(...) — sole owner of foreign key check generation
validate_table_schema_semantics(...) — pure deterministic schema semantic checks
prepare_validation_input(...) — prepare input once before slicing
extension_points: ValueValidatorKey / value rule registry entries (value.py) for adding value validators
BOOLEANIZERS and SEVERITIES vocabularies on checks
Check-kind IR classes with check_kind()/classify() dispatch
lifecycle_notes: Backend-agnostic validation plan PR-A..G all merged (#215-#222); follow-ups: PK identity tension (8j) and syntheticdata roundtrip (8k).
c1e8da53 canonical dtype schema declarations (333, #399); 838a285b shared schema declarations; 642480f8 native_identity as single recognizer; a68147b6 transit policing removed.
Failure-case schema is designed fresh, not Pandera's five columns.
documentation_hooks: Validation engine architecture: check IR, runner, result model
risks: Non-terminal ternary expressions reach backends as raw -1/0/1 sentinels (no booleanization) so rule authors must understand OutcomeProjection.
Strong coupling to expressions, relations and typespec; boundaries with conform (structural) and datacontracts (declaration) must be respected.
Public surface in __init__ is large and some names (ValueRule registry entries) are internal-leaning.
open_questions: Which of the exported names are intended as stable public API versus semi-public internals is not stated in the module; classified semi-public from __init__ exports and tests only.

evidence.detail: build_fk_checks sole owner of FK generation
